entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this and it's not working at all.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue with how the features work?
It's a fault. A big one. The pulse reading is completely inaccurate. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this product is just... it's garbage. I can't believe it.

I understand your frustration, and an incorrect pulse reading is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can certainly help with that. The first step would be to try a few troubleshooting diagnostics to see if we can resolve the connection.
Oh, I just... I really don't have time for all that. I'm working two jobs and I just needed something that worked out of the box. I just want my money back.
I see. So you'd prefer to skip troubleshooting and go straight to a return?
Yes, please. I don't mean to be difficult, but I'm exhausted and I just need a refund. I was really counting on that money if this didn't work out.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your account and our return policy. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 27 days ago. Let me just double-check the policy for you... [typing sounds]... Alright, I'm looking at our knowledge base now, and it says all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, really? So I can still return it?
Yes, absolutely. You are well within the 90-day window. I can process that return for you right now, no problem. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Oh, wow. Thank you so much, David. That is a huge relief. I really appreciate you making that so easy for me.

Of course. It's my pleasure to help. I'm sorry the product wasn't a good fit, but I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. That email is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
